## Load Libraries

```{r load-libraries}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(DESeq2)
library(sva)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplot2)

# Source custom functions
source("transcriptomics_functions.R")

out_dir = "./export/"
```

```{r load-data-models, eval=FALSE}
# Step 1: Load data
data_list <- load_transcriptomics_data(
  counts_path = './data/count_data_all.csv',
  metadata_path = "./data/metadata_ecphage.xlsx",
  annotation_path = "./data/22ET500456__with-ecolik12.csv",
  metadata_filter_col = "comment",
  metadata_filter_pattern = "missing",
  fname_col = "fname"
)

counts <- data_list$counts
metadata <- data_list$metadata
annotation <- data_list$annotation

#Step 2: remove 8 mg/L samples across times
keep_samples <- metadata %>% filter(ab_conc!=8) %>% pull(fname)
metadata_filt <- metadata %>% filter(fname %in% keep_samples)
counts_filt <- counts[,metadata_filt$fname]
metadata_filt$ab_conc <- droplevels(metadata_filt$ab_conc)
```


```{r load-data-models, eval=FALSE}

models_outs <- file.path(out_dir,"model_out")

for (t in c("1h","4h","24h")){
  
  message(paste("--Identifying DEGs for: ", t))
  deseq_results <- run_DESeq2_sva(counts_filt, metadata_filt,formula_str = "~ ab_conc * phage", 
                             time_point = t)
   run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc_4_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/venn_degs_",t,"_phage0-ab4.csv"),LFC=1,padj = 0.05)
   run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "phage_1_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/venn_degs_",t,"_phage1-ab0.csv"), LFC=1,padj = 0.05)
  
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc_4_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/all_genes_",t,"_phage0-ab4.csv"))
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "phage_1_vs_0", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/all_genes_",t,"_phage1-ab0.csv"))
  #interaction
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, coef_name = "ab_conc4.phage1", annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/all_genes_",t,"_abconc4.phage1.csv"))
  #combo ab+phage
  run_lfcShrink(deseq_results$dds, contrast_c=c( "ab_conc_4_vs_0","phage_1_vs_0", "ab_conc4.phage1")
                          , annotation=annotation,
                          out_file = paste0(models_outs,"/combo_",t,"_abconc4.phage1.csv"))
      
}

```

## combo vs mono therapy
```{r}

df_response <- assess_interactions(in_dir="./export/interaction/",
                                  out_dir = "./export/interaction/",
                                   annotation = annotation)


```

```{r}

library(patchwork)



gene_cat_df <- read.csv('./data/gene_category.csv')
pap <- plot_lfc_chicklets(df_response$data,
                   response_class = "Antibiotic-amplified-by-phage",
                   gene_category = gene_cat_df)


pcom <- plot_lfc_chicklets(df_response$data,
                   response_class = "Combination-specific",
                  filter_col = c("time_point","gene",'lfc_phage',"lfc_ab","lfc_interaction","gene_name"),
                   gene_category = gene_cat_df)

ppa <- plot_lfc_chicklets(df_response$data,
                   response_class = "Phage-modified-by-antibiotic",
                  filter_col = c("time_point","gene",'lfc_phage',"lfc_interaction","gene_name"),
                   gene_category = gene_cat_df)

p0 <- (pcom / ppa) + plot_layout(heights = c(0.9,1.1))
p <- (pap | p0) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') 

p  +  plot_layout(guides = 'collect') & theme(legend.position = 'bottom')


ggsave("./figures/response_classes_3.pdf",device = "pdf", width = 12,height = 10)
```
#combo additive dig

```{r}
pathway_gene_sets <- list(
  Divisome = c("mraZ","ftsA","ftsB","ftsE","ftsH","ftsI","ftsK","ftsL","ftsN","ftsP","ftsQ","ftsW","ftsX","ftsY","ftsZ"),
  Peptidoglycan = c("murA","murB","murC","murD","murE","murF","murG","murI","mraY","murJ","murP","murQ","murR","ampG"),

  Lpt_LPS_transport = c("lptA","lptB","lptC","lptD","lptE","lptF","lptG"),
  Waa_LPS_core = c("waaA","waaC","waaF","waaG","waaH","waaP","waaQ"),

  Porins = c("ompA","ompC","ompF","ompG","ompL","ompN","ompW","ompX","ompR","envZ"),

  Efflux_regulators = c("marA","marR","marB","marC","soxS","soxR","rob"),

                     "uvrA","uvrB","uvrC","uvrD",

df_category  <- pathway_gene_sets |>

```

```{r}
  standardize_gene_col <- function(df) {
    # Common DESeq2 csv patterns: gene, Gene, rownames stored as X or Row.names
    gene_candidates <- c("gene", "Gene", "ID", "Row.names", "row.names", "X", "X1")
    found <- gene_candidates[gene_candidates %in% colnames(df)]
    if (length(found) == 0) {
      stop("Could not find a gene column in input. Columns: ", paste(colnames(df), collapse=", "))
    }
    gene_col <- found[1]
    df <- df %>% dplyr::rename(gene = !!gene_col)
    df
  }
  
  prep_res <- function(df, prefix) {
    df <- standardize_gene_col(df)
    
    req <- c("gene", "log2FoldChange", "padj")
    missing <- setdiff(req, colnames(df))
    if (length(missing) > 0) {
      stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing, collapse=", "),
           " in file with prefix ", prefix)
    }
    
    df %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange, padj) %>%
      # enforce 1 row per gene (protect against prior merges/duplicates)
      dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        !!paste0("lfc_", prefix) := log2FoldChange,
        !!paste0("padj_", prefix) := padj
      )
  }
  
  
t<- "4h"
in_dir = "./export/interaction/"

f_phage <- file.path(in_dir, paste0("all_genes_", t, "_phage1-ab0.csv"))
f_ab <- file.path(in_dir, paste0("all_genes_", t, "_phage0-ab4.csv"))
f_int <- file.path(in_dir, paste0("all_genes_", t, "_abconc4.phage1.csv"))
f_combo <- file.path(in_dir, paste0("combo_", t, "_abconc4.phage1.csv"))

res_phage <- read.csv(f_phage, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
res_ab    <- read.csv(f_ab,    stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
res_int   <- read.csv(f_int,   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
res_combo   <- read.csv(f_combo,   stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

phage_short <- prep_res(res_phage, "phage")
ab_short    <- prep_res(res_ab,    "ab")
int_short   <- prep_res(res_int,   "interaction")
combo_short <- prep_res(res_combo,   "combo")

res_all <- phage_short %>%
  full_join(ab_short, by = "gene") %>%
  full_join(int_short, by = "gene")%>%
  full_join(combo_short, by = "gene")

 res_all <- res_all %>%
      mutate(
        sig_phage = !is.na(padj_phage) & padj_phage < 0.05 & abs(lfc_phage) > 1,
        sig_ab    = !is.na(padj_ab)    & padj_ab    < 0.05 & abs(lfc_ab) > 1,
        sig_interaction = !is.na(padj_interaction) & padj_interaction < 0.05 &
          abs(lfc_interaction) > 1,
        
        response_class = case_when(
          sig_interaction & !sig_ab & !sig_phage ~ "Combination-specific",
          sig_interaction & sig_ab & !sig_phage  ~ "Antibiotic-amplified-by-phage",
          sig_interaction & !sig_ab & sig_phage  ~ "Phage-modified-by-antibiotic",
          sig_ab & sig_phage & sig_interaction   ~ "General stress",
          sig_ab & sig_phage & !sig_interaction  ~ "Additive (no interaction)",
          sig_ab & !sig_phage & !sig_interaction ~ "Antibiotic-only",
          sig_phage & !sig_ab & !sig_interaction ~ "Phage-only",
          TRUE                                   ~ "No significant change"
        )
      ) 
 
res_additive <- res_all %>% filter(response_class=="Additive (no interaction)") %>%
      left_join(annotation, by = c("gene" = "ID"))%>%
      left_join(df_category, by = c("gene.y" = "gene_name")) %>% select(c(colnames(res_all),"gene.y","group"))
write.csv(res_additive,'./export/_temp_additive_pathways_abphaintercombo.csv')
```
